select v.vendor_name, sum(b.stake) / 100 as stake_usd
from game.bets b
join game.rounds r on r.id = b.round_ref
join game.tables t on t.table_no = r.tbl
join game.games g on g.code = t.g_code
join game.vendors v on v.vid = g.vendor
group by v.vendor_name;

SELECT v.vendor_name, SUM(b.stake) / 100.0 AS stake_usd FROM game.bets b JOIN game.rounds r ON b.round_ref = r.id JOIN game.tables t ON r.tbl = t.table_no JOIN game.games g ON t.g_code = g.code JOIN game.vendors v ON g.vendor = v.vid GROUP BY v.vendor_name ORDER BY v.vendor_name

SELECT
  r.region_name,
  COUNT(s.session_id) as sessions
FROM app.sessions s
LEFT JOIN crm.player_accounts pa ON s.player_id = pa.id
LEFT JOIN crm.agents a ON pa.agent_code = a.code
LEFT JOIN crm.regions r ON a.region_no = r.no
GROUP BY r.region_name
ORDER BY r.region_name;

SELECT
  r.region_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.session_id) as sessions
FROM app.sessions s
JOIN crm.player_accounts pa ON s.player_id = pa.id
JOIN crm.agents a ON pa.agent_code = a.code
JOIN crm.regions r ON a.region_no = r.no
GROUP BY r.region_name
ORDER BY r.region_name

SELECT r.region_name, COUNT(*) as rejected_withdrawals
FROM fin.requests fr
JOIN crm.player_accounts pa ON pa.id = fr.user_ref
JOIN crm.agents a ON a.code = pa.agent_code
JOIN crm.regions r ON r.no = a.region_no
WHERE fr.type = 1 AND fr.status = 3
GROUP BY r.region_name
ORDER BY r.region_name;

SELECT
    r.region_name,
    COUNT(*) as rejected_withdrawals
FROM fin.requests fr
JOIN crm.player_accounts pa ON fr.user_ref = pa.id
JOIN crm.agents a ON pa.agent_code = a.code
JOIN crm.regions r ON a.region_no = r.no
WHERE fr.type = 2 AND fr.status = 3
GROUP BY r.region_name
ORDER BY r.region_name;

SELECT
  a.agent_name,
  SUM(r.amount_cents) / 100.0 as deposit_usd
FROM fin.requests r
JOIN crm.player_accounts p ON p.id = r.user_ref
JOIN crm.agents a ON a.code = p.agent_code
WHERE r.type = 1 AND r.status = 2
GROUP BY a.agent_name
ORDER BY a.agent_name

SELECT
  a.agent_name,
  SUM(r.amount_cents) / 100.0 AS deposit_usd
FROM fin.requests r
JOIN crm.player_accounts p ON r.user_ref = p.id
JOIN crm.agents a ON p.agent_code = a.code
WHERE r.type = 1 AND r.status = 2
GROUP BY a.agent_name
ORDER BY a.agent_name;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT game.bets.member_ref) AS players
FROM game.bets
JOIN game.rounds ON game.bets.round_ref = game.rounds.id
JOIN game.tables ON game.rounds.tbl = game.tables.table_no
JOIN game.games ON game.tables.g_code = game.games.code
JOIN game.vendors ON game.games.vendor = game.vendors.vid
WHERE game.vendors.vendor_name = 'Aurora Studios'
  AND game.bets.member_ref IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT user_ref
    FROM fin.requests
    WHERE status = 2
  )

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.member_ref) AS players
FROM game.bets b
JOIN game.rounds r ON b.round_ref = r.id
JOIN game.tables gt ON r.tbl = gt.table_no
JOIN game.games g ON gt.g_code = g.code
JOIN game.vendors v ON g.vendor = v.vid
WHERE v.vendor_name = 'Aurora Studios'
  AND b.member_ref IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT user_ref
    FROM fin.requests
    WHERE type = 1 AND status = 2
  )

SELECT
    d.platform,
    COUNT(*) as sessions
FROM app.sessions s
JOIN app.devices d ON s.device_uid = d.device_uid
WHERE s.player_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT user_ref
    FROM fin.requests
    WHERE status = 1
)
GROUP BY d.platform
ORDER BY d.platform

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) as players
FROM crm.player_accounts p
WHERE p.id IN (
  SELECT DISTINCT b.member_ref
  FROM game.bets b
  JOIN game.rounds r ON b.round_ref = r.id
  JOIN game.tables t ON r.tbl = t.table_no
  JOIN game.games g ON t.g_code = g.code
  JOIN game.vendors v ON g.vendor = v.vid
  WHERE v.vendor_name = 'Aurora Studios'
)
AND p.id IN (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_ref
  FROM fin.requests
  WHERE status = 2
)
